Yeah, it definitely is putting a strain on things, especially with my husband. Like I said, I'm having to lean on him so much more now. Yeah, it's... it's just not the same anymore. I used to love hunting for old clasps, you know? Going to estate sales and antique shops just to find these unique, vintage pieces to incorporate into my work. And I used to plan these little jewelry classes for beginners, which was always so much fun. But lately, I mostly just stare at the trays of materials and feel like none of it is worth starting. Estate sales are really interesting, though. You get to walk through someone's entire life, basically. All their old furniture, their books, the china they probably only used on Thanksgiving. I'm sorry, I'm drifting again. What did you ask me? Oh, right, my hobbies. Yeah, I just don't have the drive for it right now. I look at my tools and the stones, and I just feel empty about it all. It's like the spark is completely gone.

I know I probably sound like a broken record today, but yes, it really doesn't matter where I am or what I'm doing. It's constantly getting in the way. Like I was saying before, my daily routine at the shop is just completely derailed. Paper manufacturing is actually a really fascinating process, if you think about it. They have to pulp the wood and press it out into these massive, continuous sheets. I visited a paper mill once on a school field trip when I was a kid. The smell was absolutely awful, kind of like sulfur or rotten eggs. I can't stand the smell of sulfur. It reminds me of those hot springs out west. My parents took me to Yellowstone when I was ten, and we saw Old Faithful erupt. It's amazing how the earth just builds up all that pressure and has to release it like that. Geothermal energy could probably power so much more of the grid than we use it for. We rely way too much on fossil fuels, and the gas prices are just ridiculous lately. I went to fill up my tank on Tuesday and I couldn't believe how much it cost to just get a half tank...

Oh, gosh, I'm sorry. I'm completely off track again, aren't I? What did you ask me? Right, my daily activities. Yes, it's just a constant struggle, whether I'm trying to talk to a client or just finish a simple jewelry repair on time. It's exhausting not being able to just do my normal routine.
